interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Read the TTTR toolbox reference and photon-clock guidance.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the original TTTR tools and their workflows.

interactive.label: Find TTTR tools
interactive.tooltip: Find tools by name, description or route.

interactive.label: ALEX Creator
interactive.tooltip: Convert ALEX macro-time modulation into micro-time so ALEX data runs through PIE pipelines.

interactive.label: Micro-time Shifter
interactive.tooltip: Apply global and per-channel micro-time shifts to TTTR files.

interactive.label: TTTR Header Editor
interactive.tooltip: View, edit, add and remove header tags in TTTR files (PTU/HT3/SPC/HDF5); saves as PTU.

interactive.label: Split / Convert
interactive.tooltip: Split large TTTR files into segments and convert between container formats.

interactive.label: Count Rate Analysis
interactive.tooltip: Count rates per detector channel across many TTTR files, with mean/std and a per-file plot.

interactive.label: Audifier
interactive.tooltip: Convert TTTR photon streams to audio, with a live micro-time / lifetime waterfall preview.

interactive.label: Tool help
interactive.tooltip: Read help for the selected TTTR tool.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Go to the previous tool in the list.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Go to the next tool in the list.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through loading, timing and conversion.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Read ALEX conversion and batch workflow help.

interactive.label: input_file
interactive.tooltip: Path of the TTTR file to convert. Press Enter (or click elsewhere) to load it; a file dropped on the window loads too.

interactive.label: Open…
interactive.tooltip: Choose a TTTR file and preview its folded ALEX phase.

interactive.label: Load
interactive.tooltip: Read the file named above.

interactive.label: Save as…
interactive.tooltip: Write the converted photon data to a new file; the input is never overwritten. Grey until a file is loaded.

interactive.label: alex_period
interactive.tooltip: ALEX alternation period (macro-time units) mapped onto micro-time.

interactive.label: period_shift
interactive.tooltip: Phase shift of the ALEX period before the macro-time to micro-time mapping.

interactive.label: Convert each
interactive.tooltip: Convert every file to its own ALEX output, or merge them all into one.

interactive.label: Merge into one
interactive.tooltip: Convert every file to its own ALEX output, or merge them all into one.

interactive.label: Add files…
interactive.tooltip: Queue TTTR files; duplicate paths are ignored.

interactive.label: Folder…
interactive.tooltip: Queue the supported TTTR files of a folder, scanned recursively.

interactive.label: Database
interactive.tooltip: Queue TTTR data from the session database.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected file from the queue; the file stays on disk. Grey until a row is selected.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Empty the queue without deleting files.

interactive.label: batch_output_folder
interactive.tooltip: Convert requires a folder; merge defaults to the folder of the first input.

interactive.label: Browse…
interactive.tooltip: Choose the output folder.

interactive.label: Run batch
interactive.tooltip: Convert each file or merge the queue using the current period, shift and formats.
